answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. Forging 158 of these means fabricating 158 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. The defence rests on charcoal burner licence: a licence the forestry body renews after burned kiln seasons. Watch the terrace: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the sonnet bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the yarrow audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
